name: telegram-file-sharing-bot
description: Telegram file-sharing bot with a FastAPI streaming web server

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram numeric user ID of the bot owner

STORAGE_CHANNEL.description: Telegram storage channel ID or @username where the bot is an admin

BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Heroku app, without a trailing slash

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Optional Telegram channel ID or @username required before downloading

MULTI_TOKEN_1.description: Optional additional Telegram bot token for multi-client downloads
